an3.41:1.1: “Bhikkhus, when three things are present, a clansman endowed with faith generates much merit.
an3.41:1.3: (1) When faith is present, a clansman endowed with faith generates much merit.
an3.41:1.4: (2) When an object to be given is present, a clansman endowed with faith generates much merit.
an3.41:1.5: (3) When those worthy of offerings are present, a clansman endowed with faith generates much merit.
an3.41:1.6: When these three things are present, a clansman endowed with faith generates much merit.”
